description: Step 1: finds every production blob of the request's media IDs (<slug>-<productId>-hires-png-rgb-oneux-<mediaId>.png with a _hash.png marker) in each locale container of prodoneuxpremium2 and freezes the result. Read-only; a continued job reuses it.

params.label: Media IDs
params.description: Only without a request input: media IDs, comma or space separated. Empty: a 'Media IDs:' line in the task. With a request they must match its files.

params.label: Work dir
params.description: Only without a request input: new, empty folder (else a 'Work dir:' line, else ~/oneux-image-replacements/<UTC timestamp>).

params.label: Locales
params.description: Locale containers to search. Empty: a 'Locales:' line in the task, else the 73 real locale containers of prodoneuxpremium2.

params.label: Image type
params.description: Rendition token before the media ID. The site reads HIRES_PNG_RGB_ONEUX.

params.label: Require _hash marker
params.description: Fail when a match has no <name>_hash.png beside it (not prescaler-managed).

portSummary: Reads request, task, names; produces mapping, report.
